notes: Urban national parks inside the Sydney span (Sydney Harbour NP, Kamay Botany Bay NP, Garigal, Lane Cove, Berowra Valley) are placed as Sydney spots because a destination for each would overlap Sydney (COVERAGE no-overlap rule); owner may prefer to promote them (Sydney Harbour NP and Kamay each have 3+ sibling spots).
Heathcote and Dharawal National Parks are standalone: single kept places each, no sibling spots, outside Sydney span; promote if review spots (Bundeena, Georges River NP) are approved.
Dharug National Park proposal is thin (Wisemans Ferry, Cattai NP kept; Old Great North Road, Marramarra NP, Scheyville NP are in review).
Ku-ring-gai proposal also holds the Pittwater beaches (Palm Beach, Whale, Avalon, Bilgola) and Barrenjoey, which no other base fits; owner may split.
